resale_co.name: Certificate of Resale
resale_co.issued_by: Borough of Elmer Housing and Property Maintenance Office
resale_co.valid_for: The application is void after 30 days.
requirements: Sidewalks in proper condition under Borough ordinance
5-inch reflective house numbers
No trash, debris or unregistered vehicles
Roof, siding, gutters and downspouts in satisfactory condition; no structural damage or rotting wood
GFI outlets outside (including sheds and garages) and within 6 feet of all water sources
Graspable handrails on steps with 3 or more risers (handrails must turn in); guard rails on decks 30 inches or higher
Pools enclosed and GFI protected
No broken windows; windows open, lock and have screens; deadbolts not keyed on both sides
Walls, floors and ceilings without holes or damage and properly painted
Working appliances with an anti-tip range; hot and cold water, working toilets and shower; bathroom exhaust fan or opening window
Water heater relief valve pipe ending 2 to 6 inches from the floor; working heating system; oil heat needs an emergency shut-off at the top of the stairs
Electrical boxes covered, circuits labeled, working outlets, switches, cover plates and fixtures; no extension cords in place of hard wiring
10-year sealed smoke detectors, 1 per level and 1 in each bedroom; carbon monoxide detectors, 1 per level near bedrooms
Fire extinguisher (2A:10B:C) mounted in the kitchen (listed on the February 2025 checklist)
All required permits obtained and approved; real estate taxes paid to date

fees.label: Certificate of Resale inspection, includes the initial inspection and 1 re-inspection

resale_co.how_to_apply: Fill out the Application for Certificate of Resale (address, block and lot, seller, buyer, realtor, settlement date, bedrooms and proposed occupants) and send it to the Housing and Property Maintenance Office at 120 S. Main Street, PO Box 882, Elmer, NJ 08318, or email housing@elmerboroughnj.com. Make checks payable to Borough of Elmer. The officer works Thursdays by appointment only. Real estate taxes must be paid to date before any certificate is issued, and the application is void after 30 days.

resale_co.notes: Elmer requires a Certificate of Resale from its Housing and Property Maintenance Office for sales (the same office issues New Tenant Certificates for rentals). The checklist and application are both marked Rev. 2/25. The checklist still lists a kitchen fire extinguisher even though P.L.2025, c.19 (February 3, 2025) removed it from the state smoke certificate rule; the Borough's own resale checklist is a local housing standard, so ask the office whether it still applies. No lead time is stated. Construction permits for Elmer are handled by the Pittsgrove Township Construction Office (856-358-2300 X6026). The Borough code is on ecode360 (EL4070) and was not opened.

requirements: 10-year sealed battery smoke alarm on every level, or hardwired where required; hardwired alarms cannot be replaced with battery alarms
Basement alarm at the bottom of the stairwell at ceiling level (not between joists)
A 10-year sealed smoke alarm in every bedroom
Smoke and carbon monoxide alarms must be less than 10 years old and working
Carbon monoxide alarm in the hallway within 10 feet of all bedrooms
A low voltage fire alarm system installed by an alarm company must be tested and certified by an alarm contractor before the inspection; bring the certification
House numbers at least 4 inches high, in a contrasting color, permanently fixed and visible from the street
Homes with solar panels, a backup generator or battery storage need a permanent, not handwritten, 'Caution: Multiple Sources of Power' style label at the main electrical panel and the electric meter

Payment is by check or money order payable to Borough of Elmer Bureau of Fire Prevention and must be received at the time of the inspection.

fire_cert.notes: Elmer's fire code enforcing agency is the Borough of Elmer Bureau of Fire Prevention, created by Ordinance No. 2025-12 (adopted October 8, 2025), which says the Bureau inspects smoke and carbon monoxide alarms and issues the certificates. The DCA registry lists Elmer as F and the DCA portal lists ELMER BORO-001 under an 'LEA'. The state directory (Elmer is code 1702 there) names Fire Official Jack Justice Jr at (856) 358-4010 and lists the 'Elmer Boro Housing Office' for smoke detector compliance; the Borough's own current forms name the Bureau of Fire Prevention at Ext. 113, which is used here. The directory's email for him is a personal-style address, so the Bureau's office email is recorded instead. The Borough's Officers page also names fire code inspectors Timothy O'Donnell and Matthew Repas. The guidelines sheet prints the middle tier as '7 business days prior', while the application form says '4 to 10 business day notice'. The fire checklist lists no fire extinguisher, in line with P.L.2025, c.19, but the Borough's separate housing resale checklist (Rev. 2/25) still asks for one.
